description: Implementation of MojoCdmService class managing Content Decryption Module (CDM) lifecycle, session handling, and communication with clients in media playback context.

classes.name: MojoCdmService
classes.description: A class managing Content Decryption Module (CDM) lifecycle, session events, and client communication in media playback.

methods.name: OnCdmCreated
methods.description: Handles post-creation setup of the CDM, including registering it and setting up decryptor if available.

methods.name: OnSessionMessage
methods.description: Handles session message events and forwards them to the client.

methods.name: OnSessionKeysChange
methods.description: Handles key change events and forwards them to the client.

methods.name: OnSessionExpirationUpdate
methods.description: Handles session expiration updates and forwards them to the client.

methods.name: OnSessionClosed
methods.description: Handles session closure events and forwards them to the client.

methods.name: OnDecryptorConnectionError
methods.description: Handles errors in decryptor connection, resets decryptor service.
